summary.text: Terri Pickens is the Democratic nominee for governor of Idaho. An attorney and fourth-generation Idahoan from Pocatello, she was the party's 2022 nominee for lieutenant governor.

Her stated priorities are preventing a nuclear waste storage campus in Idaho, housing affordability and removing the food tax, and restoring funding for public schools and rural hospitals; she supports Proposition 1 and wants to repeal the private-school tax credit.

paragraphs.text: Pickens grew up in Pocatello, won a track scholarship to the University of Southern California and earned her law degree from the University of Idaho College of Law.
She worked about three years as a public defender in Nez Perce County in the late 1990s before founding her own law firm in Boise.
Pickens is a Boise attorney and the founding partner of Pickens Law, and she lives in Boise.
She started and runs her own small business and has served on nonprofit boards.
She was the Democratic nominee for lieutenant governor in 2022, losing to Republican Scott Bedke.
